senses.gloss: (b. h. שטן; cmp. טנן, טְנָנָא)to be hostile to; to hinder, accuse.
units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 13:1">Pesik. R. s. 13</cite> (<he>על</he>) <he>אותה הברכה אתה שׂוֹטְנֵינִי וכ׳</he> thou art hostile to me on account of that blessing; it is given to you.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 12">Pesik. R. s. 12</cite>; a. e. (interch. with <he>שטם</he>).

senses.gloss: (with על) to bring charges against, accuse. Ib. s. 36 בואו ונַשְׂטִין על דורו וכ׳ come, let us bring charges against the Messianic generation, so that it may not be created. Ib. היאך אתם מַסְטִינִים וכ׳ how dare you attack &c.
